subject: Novus Platform — coordinating discovery + engineering sync

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + quick discovery — align on engineering + procurement attendees

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. I wanted to set up a short (30–40m) discovery call so we can:
- Walk the Novus use case (champion + eng lead)
- Validate data flows and security requirements for procurement
- Decide success criteria for a follow-up technical demo

Can you confirm who from your side should be on the intro (engineering lead, procurement contact, security reviewer)? I’ve CC'd Camila (ops) and Sergio (solutions engineer) so we can slot folks.

A few candidate times (PT):
- Mon 6/24 10:00–10:40
- Tue 6/25 13:30–14:10
- Wed 6/26 09:00–09:40

If none of those work, drop 2× 30–40m windows that do and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial-intake-questions.txt (text)

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — happy to get this scheduled. I’ll be the primary champion on this. I’ve looped Ben (eng lead) and procurement so they can join if needed. Prefer a morning slot next week. Ben is generally available in mornings PT.

Candidate windows from our side (PT):
- Tue 6/25 09:30–10:10 (preferred)
- Wed 6/26 10:00–10:40
- Thu 6/27 08:30–09:10

Procurement note: we’ll need a short summary of your SOC2 scope (or equivalent) and any data residency notes to satisfy our intake team.

Alyssa
Senior Product Manager, Novus Platform

Hi Alyssa —

Great — thanks for looping Ben and procurement. We can do Tue 6/25 09:30–10:10 PT. Sergio can join live for the engineering portion.

I’ve attached a very short agenda and a one-page SOC2 summary that procurement can use for intake. If procurement needs more detail, we can route to security for a formal questionnaire after the call.

Proposed agenda (30–40m):
1) 5 min — introductions + goals (Alyssa)
2) 10–15 min — high-level architecture & data flows (Ben + Sergio)
3) 10 min — security/compliance & procurement checklist (Camila)
4) 5–10 min — next steps and success criteria

Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite to all attendees.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novus-discovery-20280625
Attachments: redwood-discovery-agenda.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Camila
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
